selection_guidance: Search by capability tags and platform before selecting a resource; use the alternatives list to compare candidates in the same role.
Treat conflicts as confirmed incompatibilities only; an empty list means no conflict has been established, not that compatibility is proven.

An active entry has only passed a repository-level permissive-license screen; check the exact package/version, included assets, notices, dependencies, maintenance, security, and target compatibility before adoption.
Do not use archived research leads as app-use candidates. Copyleft, mixed-license, custom-restricted, commercial, hosted-service, and unlicensed resources stay archived until separately reviewed.
Record the exact upstream evidence URL, version or commit, compatibility target, asset scope, and the decision before changing a target application.

license_policy.research_reported_license: Reported signals in archived records are not legal clearance or proof of current upstream terms.
license_policy.verified_upstream_license: Active entries have a repository-level license file checked on the recorded date; exact package, version, assets, dependency tree, and service terms still need review.
license_policy.unverified_behavior: Active entries have unverified provenance and compatibility, and are candidates only; auto_adoption_allowed remains false.
license_policy.restricted_resources: Copyleft, commercial, source-available, mixed-license, custom-restricted, hosted-service, unlicensed, and unresolved leads are excluded from the active list and retained in the research archive.
